stories.headline: Nvidia tells server partners to pause shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US tightens export controls
stories.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners such as Dell and Supermicro to halt server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. The pause follows a new US rule requiring licenses for advanced AI chip purchases there and a closed remote-access loophole.

stories.headline: Sources say leading AI labs hold unreleased algorithmic breakthroughs that could break deployed cryptosystems; Bank of England's Bailey voices concern
stories.summary: Scott Aaronson's post reports that leading labs are sitting on major unreleased breakthroughs whose exact nature is unknown. Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey said unreleased AI models have raised encryption concerns and called for global model testing.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Releases Open Weights For Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, An Autoregressive Image Generator Outpacing GPT Image 2 With 3B Active Parameters
stories.summary: NVIDIA has quietly released open weights for Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B on Hugging Face, an autoregressive MoE image generator beating GPT Image 2.

stories.headline: XPeng unveils IRON humanoid and Turing VLA 3.0 physical AI architecture at AI Day, targeting mass production in January 2027
stories.summary: XPeng showed its IRON humanoid with about 1,500 tactile sensors alongside its Turing physical AI stack, and said it may be priced near an EV. Reports say mass production starts January 2027, with store-assistant trials in Q1 2027 and sales around Q2 2027; some sources say no price was named.
